posts.text:
Property tax on a paid-off home is the government making you rent your own land. I'm with the Governor:

We must save Florida homeowners from out of control property taxes.

A lot of people talk about fighting the left. I’ve been in the arena actually doing it for years.

Video

Join us this SATURDAY, JUNE 6 in Palm Coast for a stop on the Defending the Florida Dream Tour.  

Doors open at 5:30 PM, we'll see you there!   

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/palmcoast

I’ll never let any Florida city turn into a third-world criminal safe haven the way @JBPritzker let Chicago turn into one.

I’ll continue to crack down on criminals, enforce mandatory minimums, and back the brave men and women of law enforcement as Governor.

I'll fight every day to lower your cost of living to make Florida more affordable.

✓ Fought for No Tax on Tips. Signed into law.
✓ Fought every Democrat energy mandate driving up your power bill.
✓ Backed Trump's plan to cut prescription drug costs by up to 59%.
✓ Killed the 17-year-old rule that forced Florida condo buyers to put down 25%.
✓ Wrote the Flood Insurance Relief Act for middle-income Florida families.

As Governor, I’ll always put Florida families and seniors first.

Thank you to everyone who came out to our Women for Byron event last night! 

A special thanks to Anne Scott and my lovely wife @ErikaDonalds for hosting an incredible evening.
Great conversation and an even better breakfast at Bagel Bar East in North Miami. Nice to be back in the 305!

Border security isn't complicated. President Trump proved it.

Democrats don't want security. They want chaos.

My full breakdown on blue state madness with @Larry_Kudlow on @FoxBusiness:

Video

My full remarks during today’s Florida Means Business announcement in Miami:

Video

Florida isn't just open for business. We mean business.

Today in Miami, I launched Florida Means Business, a comprehensive plan to make Florida the fastest, most permitting-transparent state in America. 

Government delays aren't just a nuisance. That’s a job that never gets created, a business that never opens, a paycheck a family never cashes. We will streamline the process and cut the red tape.

Why are Americans paying higher prices than anyone else in the world for prescription medicines?

It’s a ripoff, and I’m fighting to fix it.

A wonderful time in Marianna and Blountstown yesterday. 

Good to be in rural Florida discussing how to make our state more affordable so that people can achieve the Florida Dream. 
 
Looking forward to seeing folks in Miami tomorrow!

The Florida Panhandle showed OUT at Gulf Coast Jam! The people, the culture, the energy — this is exactly why I’m fighting for every corner of our state. 

Great to see @rileygreenmusic and @tropicalupdate too. Florida’s best days are ahead and I’m all in.

Video

RSVP here:
byrondonalds.com/KISSIMMEE

Great campaign stops in Quincy, Marianna, and Blountstown today — and I’ll be at the Gulf Coast Jam tonight.

Join us next Friday, June 5th, in Kissimmee.

Prioritizing success pathways in education will unlock the full potential of the Florida Dream.

Video

Gadsden Tomato Company in Quincy, FL has been packaging delicious Florida tomatoes since 1982. It was a pleasure to tour their facilities with @erikadonalds today. 

The Florida tomato industry generates about $330 million a year — just one example of our state’s incredible agricultural production. 

As Governor, I will always fight for our farmers and agricultural community!

Yesterday I had the privilege of touring the floor at GMF Steel Group in Lakeland.

These folks take tremendous pride in their product — and this company provides outstanding, skilled manufacturing jobs.

These are the kind of jobs I’ll create more of as Governor.

Watch the full remarks below: my education proposal for personalized success plans for every Florida student;

Video

Great to be in Brandon this morning to roll out my education policy platform: personalized success plans for every student.

We will retool existing 6-12 grade requirements and give every student a living plan built with their parents.

There is no one-size-fits-all student — and there shouldn’t be one pathway to a career.
